name: RisuAI
ontology_notes: loreBook entries: key, secondkey, selective, alwaysActive, insertorder, content, mode (normal/folder/child). Character globalLore vs chat localLore vs module lorebooks. loadLoreBookV3Prompt in lorebook.svelte.ts. Long-term chat compression: supaMemory (LLM/BART summary) and HypaProcesser vector search (hypamemory.ts). Optional lorePlus vectordb matching (en.ts). personaPrompt. No typed relationship_state.

ontology.evidence: loreBook interface plus summary string room.supaMemoryData and hypa vector chunks. HypaProcesser memoryVector is {content, embedding}. Still strings, not relationship types.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: User authors lore. alwaysActive constant entries. Decorators in content (probability, depth, activate_only_after, keep_activate_after_match). supaMemory summarizes overflowing chat via summarize() inside supaMemory.ts. Hypa embeds those summary chunks.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: loadLoreBookV3Prompt scans loreDepth (char.loreSettings.scanDepth ?? db.loreBookDepth), keyword or regex, recursiveScanning default true, then tokenBudget (loreSettings.tokenBudget ?? db.loreBookToken). Sorted by priority then order. Hypa similaritySearch of recent chat, slice(0,3) as 'past events:'. Empty match yields no lore.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: When SupaMemoryList length >= 4 (or 3 in hyper mode), summarize(supaMemory) compresses the summary again. HypaData is an array of {id, supa, hypa} checkpoints. No fact invalidation.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: activate_only_after / activate_only_every use chatLength. keep_activate_after_match stores a chat var. Hypa search is similarity, not date. Chat objects have createdAt on messages in schema but HypaProcesser does not query by time.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: globalLore vs localLore vs getModuleLorebooks vs personaPrompt. Group chats tokenize with character names. No relationship table.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: dont_activate decorator, probability decorator, disable keys. lorePlus changes matching to vectors (experimental). No silence types.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: Activated lore content is parsed and inserted (index.svelte.ts loadLoreBookV3Prompt consumers). Scripts with lowLevelAccess can mutate lore. MCP risu-set-module-lorebook can write entries after a user prompt. No trust tags on injected text.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: Remove lore entries. dont_activate_after_match sticky-off via chat var. Summarization drops detail. No user 'forget that' across Hypa vectors except by not matching.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Lore is local tokenize vs loreToken budget. SupaMemory extra summarize LLM/BART while currentTokens > maxContextTokens, max chunk maxSupaChunkSize. Hypa embedding calls (local MiniLM etc or OpenAI embeddings). Default hypa insert 3 chunks.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: GPL-3.0 Tauri/desktop app. Local embeddings via transformers.js (MiniLM, nomic, bge). Cloud LLM/embed optional. Chat data local.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: In-process MCP client RisuAccessClient (src/ts/process/mcp/risuaccess/client.ts) named 'internal:risuai' with lorebook list/get/set tools. Also connects to external module.mcp URLs. Not a standalone published memory MCP server.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Keyword lore with a token budget, plus summary and vector overflow paths, is the same retrieve-equals-remember stack as ST. MCP can mutate lore. Still no typed relationship state.
open_unknowns: Default numeric loreBookToken and loreBookDepth in a fresh DB.
Full HypaMemory V3 path (supaMemory.ts is V1/V2 hyper; other files 404'd at guessed paths).
